title: Custom Tennis and Soccer Workout
author: Dimitri Edouard
desc:
Building strength and endurance for playing soccer and tennis 


Progression Over 12 Weeks

Weeks 1-4: Build strength, endurance, and mobility

Weeks 5-8: Increase intensity (weights, sprint distances, agility complexity)

Weeks 9-12: Focus on peak performance & match simulation
